title: Use `register_dissector()` in ASN.1 dissectors
description:
Within `epan/dissectors/asn1`, change many calls of
`create_dissector_handle()` to instead call `register_dissector()` with
a name for the dissector.

This change allows affected dissectors to be findable by calls to
`find_dissector()`. In turn, this opens up more command-line use for
these protocols, including fuzzshark and rawshark, as well as lua use
via `Dissector.get()`.

Some ASN.1 dissectors still call `create_dissector_handle()` for
dissectors that get directly passed to another handler, and are
otherwise unused. Those have been left unchanged.

Partially addresses #5612
